what: Note paper card: when it enters the 20% line inside the screen, it settles from 80px below with a .5s delay (fade-in .5s · position 1s cubic-bezier(.19,1,.22,1)). The two sheets behind it slide in from spots offset 40px sideways, 80px down and 5° off, each keeping its own tilt (the front one .25s later). Edge stickers pop on 1s late from .75x scale and 40px below.

options.[data-fx-part=sheet]: Back paper (children, two sheets) — the last one is .25s late. Its tilt is set by style --fx-tilt
options.side: If right, the paper comes in from the right (default is left) — for when cards alternate

use: …

from.where: edition.css .ed-content (original 2025 l-content left/right — bgs front/back + comps)
